svg.title: ASI construction pipeline
svg.desc: Objects grouped by directly owned attribute are indexed with multilayer hnswlib. Layer zero is exported for shared DQS; compact upper adjacency is retained for optional HNSW entry selection. Representatives and their MST are added to the bottom graph, then reverse-topological merging adds gateway edges. Full closure bitmaps are separate.

path.aria-label: ASI 构造与 DQS 的数据流
对象图：层级结构把局部近邻图接起来
父代表点 ↔ 最近子对象
查询支撑：对象导航图与属性资格位图分工
局部边 + MST 边 + 跨属性网关
